product_name: Google Distributed Cloud (software only) for bare metal

features.feature_summary: The spec.taints field in NodePoolClaim is mutable, so you can add or remove taints on existing node pools without recreating the claim.
features.extended_definition: The spec.taints field in NodePoolClaim is mutable, so you can add or remove taints on existing node pools without recreating the claim.

features.feature_summary: The bmctl upgrade intermediate-version command prints the intermediate version needed for a skip minor version upgrade.
features.extended_definition: The bmctl upgrade intermediate-version command prints the intermediate version needed for a skip minor version upgrade.

features.feature_summary: The egress NAT gateway in high availability mode supports fast failover to improve reliability and throughput for egress traffic.
features.extended_definition: The egress NAT gateway in high availability mode supports fast failover to improve reliability and throughput for egress traffic.

features.feature_summary: Horizontal Pod autoscaling can use custom metrics from a Prometheus server to scale applications without manually deploying and managing the adapter.
features.extended_definition: Horizontal Pod autoscaling can use custom metrics from a Prometheus server to scale applications without manually deploying and managing the adapter.

features.feature_summary: Vertical Pod autoscaling can use a Prometheus instance as a persistent history provider for long-term CPU and memory usage data.
features.extended_definition: Vertical Pod autoscaling can use a Prometheus instance as a persistent history provider for long-term CPU and memory usage data.

features.feature_summary: Clusters can be upgraded directly to two minor versions above the current version when worker node pools are not pinned lower.
features.extended_definition: Clusters can be upgraded directly to two minor versions above the current version when worker node pools are not pinned lower.

features.feature_summary: A bundled version of NVIDIA GPU Operator is available to manage the software components needed for GPU devices.
features.extended_definition: A bundled version of NVIDIA GPU Operator is available to manage the software components needed for GPU devices.

features.feature_summary: Dynamic Resource Allocation lets Kubernetes request and share generic resources such as GPUs among pods and containers.
features.extended_definition: Dynamic Resource Allocation lets Kubernetes request and share generic resources such as GPUs among pods and containers.

features.feature_name: Envoy sidecar in GKE Identity Service
features.feature_summary: GKE Identity Service includes an Envoy sidecar to improve security, reliability, and performance.
features.extended_definition: GKE Identity Service includes an Envoy sidecar to improve security, reliability, and performance.

features.feature_summary: Node Agent replaces Ansible over SSH with a more secure, agent-based model for cluster operations.
features.extended_definition: Node Agent replaces Ansible over SSH with a more secure, agent-based model for cluster operations.

features.feature_summary: You can override the cluster-level pod density setting for individual node pools.
features.extended_definition: You can override the cluster-level pod density setting for individual node pools.

features.feature_summary: Bare metal clusters support Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with Linux kernel versions such as 6.8 and 6.11.
features.extended_definition: Bare metal clusters support Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with Linux kernel versions such as 6.8 and 6.11.

features.feature_summary: Vertical Pod autoscaling can recommend and optionally apply CPU and memory requests and limits for pods.
features.extended_definition: Vertical Pod autoscaling can recommend and optionally apply CPU and memory requests and limits for pods.

features.feature_summary: For high availability control planes, Google Distributed Cloud automatically configures Keepalived VRRP settings to make failover behavior deterministic.
features.extended_definition: For high availability control planes, Google Distributed Cloud automatically configures Keepalived VRRP settings to make failover behavior deterministic.

features.feature_summary: This cluster configuration field sets how many gratuitous ARP messages Keepalived sends when a control plane node becomes master.
features.extended_definition: This cluster configuration field sets how many gratuitous ARP messages Keepalived sends when a control plane node becomes master.

features.feature_summary: This field enables Layer 2 load balancing and lets you separate control plane load balancing from data plane load balancing.
features.extended_definition: This field enables Layer 2 load balancing and lets you separate control plane load balancing from data plane load balancing.

features.feature_summary: The GKE Identity Service diagnostic utility provides diagnostics information for login flow and OIDC configuration issues.
features.extended_definition: The GKE Identity Service diagnostic utility provides diagnostics information for login flow and OIDC configuration issues.

features.feature_summary: The bmctl configure projects command automatically configures IAM policy bindings, creates required service accounts, and enables required APIs for Workload Identity cluster authentication.
features.extended_definition: The bmctl configure projects command automatically configures IAM policy bindings, creates required service accounts, and enables required APIs for Workload Identity cluster authentication.

features.feature_summary: The bmctl update command can show differences between the cluster YAML configuration and the deployed Cluster and NodePool resources.
features.extended_definition: The bmctl update command can show differences between the cluster YAML configuration and the deployed Cluster and NodePool resources.

features.feature_name: Concurrent management of multiple user cluster versions
features.feature_summary: Admin and hybrid clusters can manage multiple user cluster versions concurrently; Admin and hybrid clusters can manage multiple user cluster versions concurrently.
features.extended_definition: Admin and hybrid clusters can manage multiple user cluster versions concurrently; Admin and hybrid clusters can manage multiple user cluster versions concurrently.

features.feature_summary: Custom Scheduler Configuration lets pods spread workloads across cluster nodes for increased reliability.
features.extended_definition: Custom Scheduler Configuration lets pods spread workloads across cluster nodes for increased reliability.

features.feature_summary: You can set the session duration for Identity Service-issued tokens between 15 and 1440 minutes.
features.extended_definition: You can set the session duration for Identity Service-issued tokens between 15 and 1440 minutes.

features.feature_summary: Keyless mode uses short-lived tokens and Workload Identity Federation instead of long-lived service account keys and Kubernetes Secrets.
features.extended_definition: Keyless mode uses short-lived tokens and Workload Identity Federation instead of long-lived service account keys and Kubernetes Secrets.

features.feature_summary: The connect gateway preview feature enables kubectl attach, cp, and exec commands through gcloud beta container fleet memberships get-credentials.
features.extended_definition: The connect gateway preview feature enables kubectl attach, cp, and exec commands through gcloud beta container fleet memberships get-credentials.

features.feature_summary: You can roll back select node pool upgrades; You can roll back select node pool upgrades.
features.extended_definition: You can roll back select node pool upgrades; You can roll back select node pool upgrades.

features.feature_summary: You can configure private registries at the node level for workload images; You can configure private registries at the node level for workload images.
features.extended_definition: You can configure private registries at the node level for workload images; You can configure private registries at the node level for workload images.

features.feature_summary: Bare metal clusters support Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 in version 1.29.400-gke.86 and higher.
features.extended_definition: Bare metal clusters support Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 in version 1.29.400-gke.86 and higher.

features.feature_summary: Maintenance mode now drains nodes with the Eviction API instead of taint-based draining to better protect workloads.
features.extended_definition: Maintenance mode now drains nodes with the Eviction API instead of taint-based draining to better protect workloads.

features.feature_summary: GKE Identity Service v2 improves the security flow when authenticating with third-party identity solutions; Provides an improved authentication flow with third-party identity solutions.
features.extended_definition: GKE Identity Service v2 improves the security flow when authenticating with third-party identity solutions; Provides an improved authentication flow with third-party identity solutions.

features.feature_summary: You can use an intermediate Certificate Authority as the cluster root CA.
features.extended_definition: You can use an intermediate Certificate Authority as the cluster root CA.

features.feature_summary: You can pause and resume cluster upgrades.
features.extended_definition: You can pause and resume cluster upgrades.

features.feature_name: Selective node pool upgrades with two-minor-version skew
features.feature_summary: Selective node pool upgrades can span up to two minor versions; Allows selective node pool upgrades when the version skew is up to two minor versions.
features.extended_definition: Selective node pool upgrades can span up to two minor versions; Allows selective node pool upgrades when the version skew is up to two minor versions.

features.feature_summary: Adds BGP Community support so routes from BGP load balancers can be distinguished from other network routes.
features.extended_definition: Adds BGP Community support so routes from BGP load balancers can be distinguished from other network routes.

features.feature_summary: Lets you pause and later resume cluster upgrades.
features.extended_definition: Lets you pause and later resume cluster upgrades.

features.feature_summary: Lets you use custom certificate authorities for cluster authentication and encryption.
features.extended_definition: Lets you use custom certificate authorities for cluster authentication and encryption.

features.feature_summary: Adds Direct Server Return load balancing for clusters; Adds Direct Server Return load balancing for clusters configured with flat-mode networking.
features.extended_definition: Adds Direct Server Return load balancing for clusters; Adds Direct Server Return load balancing for clusters configured with flat-mode networking.

features.feature_summary: Lets you specify a fleet membership's region with gkeConnect.location.
features.extended_definition: Lets you specify a fleet membership's region with gkeConnect.location.

features.feature_name: Kubernetes API server certificate extra SANs
features.feature_summary: Lets you add extra subject alternative name entries to the Kubernetes API server certificate.
features.extended_definition: Lets you add extra subject alternative name entries to the Kubernetes API server certificate.

features.feature_summary: Lets you define multiple BGPLoadBalancer resources to control how peers advertise load balancer nodes and services.
features.extended_definition: Lets you define multiple BGPLoadBalancer resources to control how peers advertise load balancer nodes and services.

features.feature_summary: Adds support for running clusters on Red Hat Enterprise Linux version 9.2.
features.extended_definition: Adds support for running clusters on Red Hat Enterprise Linux version 9.2.

features.feature_summary: Automatically enrolls admin and user clusters in the Anthos On-Prem API for lifecycle management.
features.extended_definition: Automatically enrolls admin and user clusters in the Anthos On-Prem API for lifecycle management.

features.feature_summary: Adds a target-cluster-name flag to bmctl register for specifying the target cluster.
features.extended_definition: Adds a target-cluster-name flag to bmctl register for specifying the target cluster.

features.feature_summary: Adds a health check that detects unsupported drift in custom resources managed by the platform.
features.extended_definition: Adds a health check that detects unsupported drift in custom resources managed by the platform.

features.feature_summary: Adds a separate always-on etcd instance for the etcd-events object.
features.extended_definition: Adds a separate always-on etcd instance for the etcd-events object.

features.feature_summary: Lets selected worker node pools be upgraded separately from the rest of the cluster.
features.extended_definition: Lets selected worker node pools be upgraded separately from the rest of the cluster.

features.feature_summary: Lets you configure image pull settings for node pool kubelets.
features.extended_definition: Lets you configure image pull settings for node pool kubelets.

features.feature_summary: Lets LoadBalancer Services use externalTrafficPolicy=Local with bundled BGP load balancing.
features.extended_definition: Lets LoadBalancer Services use externalTrafficPolicy=Local with bundled BGP load balancing.

features.extended_definition: Lets worker node pools be upgraded in parallel.

features.extended_definition: Adds support for running clusters on Red Hat Enterprise Linux version 8.8.
